Subject: Crestline pilot — request to align MAP + DPA gating (CREST-5247)

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement here — we want to lock the evaluation/acceptance timeline before our legal team begins redlines. Two asks to keep this moving: 

1) A mutual action plan (MAP) that aligns evaluation milestones (pilot data, acceptance run, support window) with contract gating (MSA/DPA/order form).
2) A short evidence index (SOC2, data retention + access, egress controls) so our security team can triage quickly.

Can you share a MAP template that includes: milestone owners, expected dates, dependencies (legal sign, order form), and fallback if DPA redline takes longer than expected? We're targeting a pilot kickoff week of 2025-11-10 but can be flexible if legal needs more runway.

Elena Morris
Sr. Procurement Manager — Crestline Health

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a baseline MAP for Crestline (Crestline_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short Evidence Index to speed your security review. High-level plan below: 

- Week of 2025-11-03: Prep & SSO test (owner: Crestline IT)
- Week of 2025-11-10: Pilot kickoff (owner: Crestline PM + Redwood CSM)
- 2-week evaluation run: acceptance tests (owner: Crestline QA)
- Contract gating: MSA signature required before pilot kickoff; DPA must be either signed or an approved risk exception documented by Crestline legal. Order form to follow once commercial terms are agreed.

Dependencies/fallbacks I recommend adding into the MAP: 
- If DPA redline extends >10 business days, Redwood can provision a scoped private instance under a temporary data-handling addendum (we can scope data fields and retention) until DPA is finalized.
- Acceptance criteria must be explicit (pass rate, latency envelope, sample prompts) — I put a short checklist in the MAP.

Next steps: 
1) Review attached MAP + Evidence Index and mark owners/dates.
2) If your legal has specific redline terms, please share the DPA and we'll provide a marked draft (Marissa will own legal coordination).
3) Proposal: 30% credit holdback for pilot if DPA is unsigned at kickoff — optional, we can drop if legal moves faster.

I'm copying Marissa (contracts) and Karthik (onboarding/acceptance) so we can triage technical gating and legal timing.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
